assets.title: Female, Male & Intersex Reproductive Structures
assets.purpose: Show female preflowers, developing male pollen structures and representative intersex structures at multiple developmental stages under consistent macro framing.
assets.diagnosticUse: Reduces misidentification of young floral tissue and keeps suspect vs confirmed observations separate.

assets.title: Reproductive Inspection Map — Where to Look
assets.purpose: Show systematic inspection of nodes, lower/interior branches, later-forming sites and representative reproductive zones across a plant.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents one top-branch check from being treated as complete reproductive scouting.

assets.title: Pollen Structure — Closed, Opening & Released
assets.purpose: Show a realistic sequence of pollen-producing structures from closed through opening and post-release state without implying an exact universal release schedule.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps reconstruct whether an internal source could have released pollen before removal or discovery.

assets.title: Pollen Drift Risk — Source + Wind + Flowering Overlap
assets.purpose: Combine source bearing/distance, changing wind, reproductive timing and uncertainty to explain why no fixed isolation radius guarantees zero risk.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents geographic distance alone from being used as proof for or against an external pollen source.

assets.title: Seed-Set Progression & Sampling Reference
assets.purpose: Show suspect swelling, confirmed developing seed and mature seed with sampling locations and explicit uncertainty around exact pollination date.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish seed development from normal flower swelling and creates consistent seed-set sampling records.

assets.title: Unexpected Seed Set — Internal, External or Unresolved?
assets.purpose: Walk through internal pollen-source audit, external source/wind overlap, spatial seed-set pattern and parentage uncertainty.
assets.diagnosticUse: Stops circumstantial field evidence from being promoted to proven donor identity and shows when genetic parentage testing is the stronger evidence path.
